messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — PineBridge POC needs SOC2 artifacts + a signed pen-test letter before legal will greenlight dev VPC access.
omar: Got it. Which artifacts specifically? SOC 2 Type II report? ISO cert? CSPM logs?
maya: Customer asked for: SOC 2 Type II report summary, ISO 27001 cert, pen-test attestation (signed), and a short statement about data residency. They also want confirmation on M365/Okta SSO flow for the POC.
tara: For pen-test letter we usually provide the standard pen-test attestation PDF. I can pull it but legal needs to sign — give me 24–48h.
maya: Customer timeline: POC kickoff next Tue, needs evidence by Mon EOD to avoid delay. Any way to expedite? :eyes: 
omar: We can provide SOC2 summary + bridge letter today. Full report needs an NDA; have we got one signed?
maya: Sales has a redlined NDA out, waiting on signature. What about staging creds — can we give ephemeral creds without SSO if legal says no?
alex: We can stand up a dedicated POC project and enable temporary API keys scoped to non-prod data. Need eng-ops approval for VPC peering though.
security-bot: Incident/Compliance request logged: ID C-2026-4487 — team security notified.
tara: To speed up, I'll produce the pen-test attestation and a short SSO notes doc. If NDA lands, we can release the SOC2 report via secure link.
omar: Pricing question from the customer: if we move from hosted to Dedicated for the POC, what's the uplift and lead time?
alex: Dedicated short-term bump is typically 1.5–2x committed price, with 2–3 day provisioning in most regions. Can confirm exact numbers if you share region and expected QPS.
maya: Region: us-east-1. Expected peak 50 rps, baseline 10 rps during POC for eval. Also ask about whether dedicated includes audit logging retention increase (customer wants 1 year).
eng-qa: Audit logs retention increase is an enterprise add-on, can be enabled for POC as temporary configuration. Need approval from product pricing team.
tara: I'll attach: pen-test-attestation.pdf (internal), sso-notes.md.
maya: Awesome. Please also cc security@redwood.com when you send the final package to the customer.
security-bot: Evidence package uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-compliance/pinebridge/1766667890/ — link expires in 7 days.
maya: Perfect — tagging @omar @tara @alex. Can someone confirm if we can ship the SOC2 summary without signed NDA? Customer pushing hard.
omar: We can share the SOC2 summary (no controls evidence) publicly. Full report requires NDA/portal access agreement.
maya: Thanks team. I'll tell the customer: pen-test letter + pen summary today, SOC2 summary now, full report after NDA. Also share tentative Dedicated pricing and provisioning ETA.
alex: I'll draft the Dedicated quote and send to you in channel DM.
eng-qa: Ping me if legal needs a formal attestation for log retention.
maya: Closing loop — if NDA signs before EOD tomorrow, we can send full report and enable dedicated staging by Tue. :thumbsup:
